It runs under a per-document budget, heldBudget = 2^21 steps, about 7.4 ms at worst (BenchmarkHeldAlternations). Past the budget it falls back to the program's full alternation count. The stack is now charged (n+1)*held+1 jobs: held is 3 for the WHATWG e-mail pattern (it was charged 126), 2 for the hostname pattern (was 124), and 241 for (?:(?:a??){240}a)*b, where the bound is tight. backtrackProgs keeps only the size/held frontier.
